{
  "candidate_rtl": "module comparator_16bit (
    input [15:0] A,
    input [15:0] B,
    output gt,
    output eq,
    output lt
);
    wire [15:0] same;
    wire [3:0] group_eq;
    wire [3:0] group_gt;
    wire [3:0] group_lt;

    assign same = ~(A ^ B);

    genvar k;
    generate
        for (k = 0; k < 4; k = k + 1) begin : groups
            assign group_eq[k] = &same[4*k +: 4];
            assign group_gt[k] =
                (A[4*k+3] & ~B[4*k+3]) |
                (same[4*k+3] & A[4*k+2] & ~B[4*k+2]) |
                (same[4*k+3] & same[4*k+2] & A[4*k+1] & ~B[4*k+1]) |
                (same[4*k+3] & same[4*k+2] & same[4*k+1] & A[4*k] & ~B[4*k]);
            assign group_lt[k] = ~(group_gt[k] | group_eq[k]);
        end
    endgenerate

    assign eq = &group_eq;
    assign gt = group_gt[3] |
                (group_eq[3] & group_gt[2]) |
                (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_gt[1]) |
                (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_eq[1] & group_gt[0]);
    assign lt = group_lt[3] |
                (group_eq[3] & group_lt[2]) |
                (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_lt[1]) |
                (group_eq[3] & group_eq[2] & group_eq[1] & group_lt[0]);
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "Magnitude comparison requires resolving the highest differing bit. Long serial priority or carry-like paths can dominate mapped arrival time.",
  "rewrite": "Compute four unsigned four-bit comparisons in parallel, sharing bit equality signals. Form local less-than results from local greater-than and equality, then combine the four groups using explicit lookahead equations for both magnitude outputs.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The explicit four-bit grouping targets shorter magnitude-resolution paths and avoids deriving lt from the final gt output. Actual timing gain and electrical-limit compliance require the specified mapping and STA flow; no measured gain is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Shares equality and local comparison logic rather than duplicating full greater-than and less-than comparators. Group-combination logic adds some overhead; compliance with the 547.775360um2 area cap remains to be measured.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Exact combinational unsigned comparison for every binary assignment of A and B. Within each group and across groups, the most significant differing bit determines magnitude. Local lt is the complement of local gt or equality, which is exact for binary unsigned operands. Module name, ports, widths, and unsigned interpretation are unchanged; there are no parameters, state, assumptions, or undefined outputs."
}
